strategic_thesis: Authentic dum biryani cannot be rushed, so the brands that sell speed are selling something else; the only proof that matters is a sealed handi that takes six hours over coal embers and cracks open to reveal what shortcuts cannot produce.
core_tension: The audience wants convenience but has quietly learned to distrust it in food: they are tired of reheated, uniformly pre-assembled meals yet still expect instant availability. Copper & Clay forces a choice between speed and genuine craft, and its 80-portion ceiling makes refusal to compromise feel like a privilege rather than a limitation.
